DENSE STAR FIELD: a sky crowded with stars from horizon to zenith, a soft pale band of the Milky Way arcing across
SPARSE STAR FIELD: a wide dark sky holding a handful of bright stars scattered wide apart, each one sharp and still
MILKY WAY BAND: a broad luminous river of stars sweeps overhead, its core bright and dusty with countless packed suns
BIG BRIGHT STARS: a few large brilliant stars dominate the sky, each burning steady and prominent among fainter scattered points
STARS THROUGH THIN CLOUD: gauzy wisps of cloud drift across the sky, stars glowing softly through the translucent shifting veil
THIN CRESCENT MOON: a slender silver crescent hangs low, its curve sharp and bright against a deep indigo sky
CRESCENT MOON WITH STARS: a fine crescent moon arcs gently overhead, a dusting of stars arranged loosely all around it
LOW CRESCENT MOON: a thin crescent moon rests just above the horizon line, glowing warm amber in the thicker air
FULL MOON: a wide bright full moon rides high overhead, flooding the sky with cool silver luminance in every direction
GIBBOUS MOON: a nearly full gibbous moon climbs the eastern sky, its face detailed and bright, haloed in soft pearl
FULL MOON LOW CLOUD: a full moon floats above a ragged cloud layer, its light spreading wide across the cloud tops
GREEN AURORA CURTAIN: long rippling curtains of green aurora stretch across the northern sky, folding and swaying in slow pulses
VIOLET AND GREEN AURORA: bands of deep violet and vivid green aurora spiral overhead, their edges blurring into one another softly
AURORA OVERHEAD BLOOM: the aurora blooms directly overhead in radiating green and violet rays, spreading outward like a slow luminous crown
LOW SNOW CLOUD: a flat heavy ceiling of cloud, faintly lit from below, its underside soft and even
THICK SNOW CEILING: a dense matte cloud ceiling presses low across the whole sky, glowing faintly with a muted amber tinge
HEAVY CLOUD GLOW: billowing heavy cloud fills the sky from edge to edge, its pale underbelly softly suffused with orange warmth
SNOW CLOUD LAYERS: stacked layers of swollen cloud spread across the sky, their bases smooth and grey, catching a dim rosy glow
STORM CLEARING RAGGED: ragged torn cloud edges retreat across the sky, gaps between them opening to reveal sharp clusters of stars
CLEARING STORM SKY: the last of a storm's cloud breaks apart overhead, leaving jagged dark shreds amid widening patches of clear starfield
STORM GAP STARS: heavy cloud splits along a widening seam, a bright rift of open star-filled sky stretching through the middle
HIGH THIN CLOUD VEIL: a smooth translucent sheet of high cloud spreads across the sky, stars visible as soft diffused points through it
HIGH CIRRUS VEIL: fine high cirrus fans thinly across the stars, giving each point of light a faint blurred halo
HORIZON CLOUD BANK: a solid bank of cloud hugs the horizon, dark and layered, while the upper sky opens clear and star-filled
LOW CLOUD CLEAR TOP: a thick cloud bank lies along the horizon, soft and still, the sky above it deep and full of stars
